# USING THE CODE FROM ELASTIC NET 

The goal is to get a list of selected genes after running elastic net to use in random forest. 

```{r}
# Loading the dataset
analysis_tpm <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "analysis_tpm.rds"))

# visualizing dataset
analysis_tpm[, 1:10] %>%
  head(5)

# outcome = Day 7 plasmablast frequency
y_vec <- analysis_tpm$pf_d7

# Log-transform Day 7 plasmablast frequency
y_log <- log(y_vec)

# Store predictions and selected hyperparameters
log_predictions <- rep(NA_real_, length(y_vec))
log_alphas <- rep(NA_real_, length(folds))
log_lambdas <- rep(NA_real_, length(folds))

# Wider lambda grid for the log-transformed outcome
log_elastic_net_grid <- expand.grid(
  alpha = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
  lambda = c(
    0.000001,
    0.00001,
    0.0001,
    0.001,
    0.01,
    0.05,
    0.1,
    0.2,
    0.5,
    1
  )
)

## Recording genes to use in RF
log_genes_available <- rep(NA_integer_, length(folds))
log_genes_selected <- rep(NA_integer_, length(folds))

# Store selected genes for each outer fold
log_selected_genes_by_fold <- vector("list", length(folds))

for (i in seq_along(folds)) {
  cat("Running log-transformed model - outer fold", i, "\n")

  test_idx <- folds[[i]]

  # Split expression data
  X_train <- X_mat[-test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  X_test <- X_mat[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]

  # Use log-transformed outcome
  y_train <- y_log[-test_idx]

  # Remove zero-variance genes using training data only
  keep_genes <- apply(X_train, 2, var) > 0

  X_train <- X_train[, keep_genes, drop = FALSE]
  X_test <- X_test[, keep_genes, drop = FALSE]

  # Fit elastic net with inner 5-fold CV
  log_model <- caret::train(
    x = X_train,
    y = y_train,
    method = "glmnet",
    tuneGrid = log_elastic_net_grid,
    trControl = trainControl(
      method = "cv",
      number = 5,
      summaryFunction = rmse_only
    ),
    metric = "RMSE",
    preProcess = c("zv", "center", "scale"),
    standardize = FALSE
  )
  
  # Number of genes available after variance filtering
  log_genes_available[i] <- ncol(X_train)
  
  # Extract coefficients at selected lambda
  selected_coefs <- coef(
    log_model$finalModel,
    s = log_model$bestTune$lambda
  )
  
  # Identify genes with nonzero coefficients
  selected_genes <- rownames(selected_coefs)[
    as.vector(selected_coefs != 0)
  ]
  
  # Remove intercept
  selected_genes <- setdiff(selected_genes, "(Intercept)")
  
  # Store selected genes for this fold
  log_selected_genes_by_fold[[i]] <- selected_genes
  
  # Count selected genes
  log_genes_selected[i] <- length(selected_genes)

  # Predict on log scale and back-transform
  pred_log <- predict(log_model, newdata = X_test)

  log_predictions[test_idx] <- exp(pred_log)

  # Save selected parameters
  log_alphas[i] <- log_model$bestTune$alpha
  log_lambdas[i] <- log_model$bestTune$lambda
}

# Calculate gene selection frequency across outer folds
log_gene_frequency <- sort(
  table(unlist(log_selected_genes_by_fold)),
  decreasing = TRUE
)

# Create gene stability table
log_gene_stability <- data.frame(
  Gene = names(log_gene_frequency),
  Selection_count = as.integer(log_gene_frequency),
  Selection_frequency = as.numeric(log_gene_frequency) /
    length(folds))

head(log_gene_stability)

# Display most frequently selected genes
head(log_gene_stability, 20)

# Result table 
gene_selected_tb <- data.frame(
  fold = seq_along(folds),
  alpha = log_alphas,
  lambda = log_lambdas,
  genes_available = log_genes_available,
  genes_selected = log_genes_selected )
```
- no gene is selected across all folds

- Inconsistent number of genes selected across folds
